statement: The partition leader answers a learner promotion proof from its committed configuration and its own admission record: the learner's host is a field of the admitted identity recorded when the leader admitted the peer, never looked up in the CDC-fed services cache. The cache-address resolution paths behind buildPeerAddress for promotion and transport, and the refusal cause learner_address_unresolvable, are deleted; the only refusals are NOT_LEADER and NOT_IN_CONFIGURATION. On a fresh three-node formation no promotion proof is refused for a replica named in the committed configuration, the priority control-plane spread reaches readyDistinctNodeCount 3 within the stated bound, and time-to-serve-lane is recorded.

constraints.statement: Instance C2/C3 of the class 'serve-gating decision consumes a projection' (evidence/systemic-analysis-serve-lane-2026-11-01.md in comparative-benchmark-evidence-repair). The repair moves the decision onto the committed fact; it adds no timer, retry, carve-out, cache wait or alternate resolution path, and deletes the existing ones for this decision.

Continues owner decision O1/A8 (committed-membership bootstrap read 2026-09-25/26): rows are discovery, never authority; the admission record is extended with the admitted node identity and read back through the raft-rs runtime owner, not re-derived.

Red first at the unit level (proof handler resolves host from admission/committed configuration; cache row absent or stale does not change the answer; unknown replica refuses NOT_IN_CONFIGURATION), then the live scenario fresh-formation-user-table-routability on local-three-node.json red before, green three consecutive after, with node logs retained; independent verification before landing.
